purpose: Select local files, show bounded validation and optionally invoke a host-supplied cancellable upload adapter.
behaviorProvider: Native file input/drag-drop with shared Button, IconButton and ProgressBar.

component: Accept native selection and dropped files. Match accept by extension, MIME type or wildcard; check size, count and duplicates identified by filename/size/lastModified. multiple=false replaces the prior selection only when a valid replacement is accepted.
Store accepted File objects as ready items with generated IDs. Without onUpload, files remain local. Clear the native file input after selection so the same file can be selected again.

Only an explicit upload/retry action invokes onUpload(file,{signal,onProgress}). Bound finite progress to 0–100; resolving marks complete, rejection marks error. Ignore stale/aborted progress or completion updates.
Abort registered tasks on cancel, removal, external item disappearance and unmount. Cancel returns a row to ready. Restore row action focus on state transitions and Choose files focus after removal.
host: When value is supplied, accept onValueChange item updates to keep the controlled list synchronized. Own stable item IDs and transport/storage consistency.

Implement actual upload, authorization, server-side validation, content scanning, retries and persistence. Honor AbortSignal to stop underlying work; client accept and metadata checks are convenience checks, not security validation.

Owned styling belongs to the input token group. Actual nested shared components retain their own group and behavior; preserve four theme/mode mappings and keyboard-visible focus.

limitations: Source-backed requirements, not a current test certification or release approval.
No native form file name or automatic submission is supplied; accepted files are passed through callbacks.
Disabling the control prevents new user actions but does not automatically cancel an upload already running.
A resolved adapter is trusted as success; the wrapper cannot establish server integrity or undo an upload after remote acceptance.
